authentication_bypass.details: All 8 protected route handlers (settings, campaigns, video/*, test-connection) call requireMarketingSession() as the first statement and return 401 before any DB read/write or AI call. No catch block or error path exposes sensitive data.

session_validation.details: requireMarketingSession delegates to requireAuth from @reading-advantage/auth, which drives getSession -> validateSession. The session_token cookie is read and validated before downstream logic.

secret_leakage.details: GET /api/settings masks secret-shaped keys (apiKey/secret/token) as '••••' and never decrypts. AI route error handlers redact apiKey. test-connection now requires auth so unauthenticated callers cannot probe keys.

zod_validation.details: Campaign, topic, and script-request schemas now use .strict() to reject unknown fields. generateScript bounds topic to 50KB. Settings uses z.record(z.string(), z.string()). All mutating routes validate before side effects.

sql_orm_injection.details: All DB access uses parameterized Drizzle queries. No raw string interpolation of user input.

prompt_injection.details: generate-script validates app/topic with strict Zod before buildScriptGenerationPrompt. Topic is length-bounded and placed in a delimited slot; unknown fields are rejected by .strict().

tenant_owner_scoping.details: Marketing tables are REFERENTIAL with no schoolId/ownerId. Routes document the honest global-internal policy and gate on auth + role floor. No fabricated fake schoolId scope.

ai_adapter.details: generate-script, research-topics, and test-connection route through createAIClient from @reading-advantage/ai. No per-request provider SDK instantiation; API key is injected at adapter construction time.

error_messages.details: 500 responses use generic messages. video/projects no longer echoes error.message. No stack traces or provider responses containing API keys are returned.

csrf.details: All state-mutating POST/PATCH routes require a valid session via session_token cookie before processing.

logging.details: No console.log of raw secrets or decrypted values. Health route logs generic error message only.

a2_consent_blind_publish_gate.details: Phase 2 has no draft-to-published transition for named subjects. Campaign status transitions are internal workflow only and do not expose named individuals.

a6_registry_overstatement.details: tracks.md does not claim the marketing security vulnerabilities are resolved beyond the adversarial tests. All Phase 2 security tests (phase-w3-*) are green.
